name: profile_editing
title: Profile editing: property updates + profile reads
expect: Condensed props; never Chunked props (a 62 KB chunk per update)
why: one type, two opposite needs. Reading a whole profile wants Condensed properties (1 GET against 7). Updating lastName wants Split: {sp_upd} written, against a rewritten {cc_upd} row (Condensed) or a {ch_upd} chunk (Chunked). Both needs sit on Person properties, so a mixed layout cannot separate them.

why_scale_free.1: a Condensed row is one key
why_scale_free.7: a Person declares 7 properties (schema): one key each in Split
